training_contract.hard_negative_policy: For each train query, rank TRAIN documents only with the pinned unfine-tuned baseline and select the highest-ranked non-positive document. Dev/test documents and qrels are never visible to mining or training.
training_contract.selection_policy: Hyperparameters are frozen before any fine-tuned dev/test result. Dev is diagnostic only; do not select a test-facing configuration after inspecting test metrics.
training_contract.test_integrity: Do not change documents, queries, qrels, split membership, model revision, optimizer hyperparameters, or mining policy after the first fine-tuned result is inspected.
